entities.name: Grzegorz Antoni Ogiński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Grzegorz Antoni Ogiński was the Elder of Samogitia (1698–1709), Field Hetman of Lithuania (1703–1709) and Grand Hetman of Lithuania in 1709. He was the fourth and youngest son of Jan Jacek Ogiński, a Field Hetman of Lithuania.
